arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
p=/opt/telegram-leads-optin
printf 'PATH=%s\n' "$p"
if [ ! -d "$p" ]; then echo 'PATH_MISSING'; exit 0; fi
printf 'PATH_DETAILS\n'
sudo -n stat -c '%F|%a|%U:%G|%s|%y' "$p"
sudo -n du -sh "$p"
printf 'FILES\n'
sudo -n find "$p" -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%P|%s bytes\n' | head -80
printf 'DIRS\n'
sudo -n find "$p" -maxdepth 3 -type d -printf '%P\n' | head -50
printf 'REFERENCES_SYSTEMD\n'
sudo -n grep -rIlF '/opt/telegram-leads-optin' /etc/systemd/system /etc/cron.d /etc/crontab 2>/dev/null || :
printf 'REFERENCES_PM2\n'
sudo -n grep -lF '/opt/telegram-leads-optin' /root/.pm2/dump.pm2 /home/ubuntu/.pm2/dump.pm2 2>/dev/null || :
printf 'REFERENCES_ACTIVE_ROBOT\n'
sudo -n grep -rlF '/opt/telegram-leads-optin' /opt/telegram-robot-leads --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*.session' --exclude='*.log' 2>/dev/null | head -30 || :
printf 'ACTIVE_PROCESSES_BY_CWD\n'
for f in /proc/[0-9]*/cwd; do x=$(sudo -n readlink "$f" 2>/dev/null || :); case "$x" in /opt/telegram-leads-optin*) echo "$f" ;; esac; done
printf 'ACTIVE_ROBOT_PRESENT\n'
sudo -n test -d /opt/telegram-robot-leads && echo yes || echo no
printf 'DONE=PASS\n'
